displayName: Aurelius X | Volvo FH | 6x2 Truck Cabin
description: An elegant, gold-themed premium cabin skin set against a deep, dark background. Aurelius X blends regal aesthetics with bold detailing, delivering a luxurious and commanding appearance for the Volvo FH.

Vantor combines a matte graphite foundation with brushed titanium surfaces and intricate carbon-fibre detailing. Electric-blue accents cut through the dark metallic finish, creating a refined, futuristic design with a bold industrial character.
Golden Edges brings a refined touch of luxury to the Volvo FH mirrors, featuring elegant golden accents that add definition, contrast and a premium finish to the truck's exterior.

An elegant, gold-themed premium trailer skin set against a deep, dark background. Aurelius X combines regal aesthetics with bold detailing, giving the Box Trailer a luxurious and commanding appearance.
